SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 宥万先生！您清醒些了吗？
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 宥萬先生！你聽得到我的聲音嗎？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ユマンさん！気が付きましたか？

SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 还好意识清醒真是万幸....
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 意識があってよかったです…
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Ya, yang penting masih sadar lah…
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Ainda bem que você continua consciente…

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 선생님 우유만 씨는 왜 뻑 하면 쓰러지는 거예요?
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Doctor, why does Yuman faint every five seconds?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 方护士，吴宥万怎么动不动就晕倒啊？
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 醫生，吳宥萬先生為什麼動不動就暈倒啊？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 先生、ウ・ユマンさんはどうしてこんなによく倒れるんですか？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Dok, kenapa sih Yuman pingsan mulu tiap lima detik?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Enfermeira, por que o Yuman desmaia tão facilmente?
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Enfermera, ¿por qué Yuman se desmaya tan fácilmente?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: دکتر چرا یومان هر پنج ثانیه بیهوش می شود؟

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Maybe because you had him back at work right after giving birth…
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 那不是因为刚痊愈就被逼着马上上班嘛...
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 因為他人才剛痊癒就回去上班了啊...
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 回復してすぐ職場復帰させるからでしょ…
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Mungkin karena kalian suruh dia kerja lagi abis ngelahirin…
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Porque fizeram ele voltar ao trabalho quando ainda tava se recuperando...
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Pues porque lo hicieron volver al trabajo apenas se estaba recuperando...
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: شاید به خاطر همین که بلافاصله پس از زایمان اونو به سر کار بازگردانده اید…

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 다들 잠깐만 지금 뭐라고 하는 거 같은데요?
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Wait, hold on—did he just say something?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 你们等一下，他好像在说什么？
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 大家等一下，他好像說了什麼？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ちょっと待って、今なんか言ってるみたいだけど？
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Um momento, alguém disse alguma coisa?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: صبر کن، صبر کن - او فقط چیزی گفت؟

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 아, 물이요?? 오빠 제가 얼른 떠다 줄게요!
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Oh! Water? Oppa, I’ll go get it right now!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 啊，要水？？哥哥我马上给你拿！
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 啊，水嗎？？你等等，我馬上去幫你倒！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: え、水！？お兄さん、私がすぐ持ってくるね！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Oh! Air ya? Oppa, aku ambilin sekarang deh!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Ah, água? Oppa, eu trago pra você agora mesmo!
SCRIPT.SPANISH: ¿Ah, agua? ¡Oppa, yo te la traigo enseguida!
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: اوه! آب؟ یومان، من همین الان میرم بیارمش!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: We’re in a hospital—and I’m the nurse, remember?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 这里是医院，而且我才是护士吧？
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 這裡是醫院，我是護理師
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ここ病院ですよ？“私”が看護師ですから
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Ini kan rumah sakit—aku perawatnya, inget nggak?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: A gente tá num hospital e eu sou a enfermeira, lembra?
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Estamos en un hospital y yo soy la enfermera.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: ما در بیمارستان هستیم - و من پرستار هستم، یادت هست؟

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 저도 돌보미 알바해 봐서 잘할 수 있는데...
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: I’ve done caregiver gigs before—I can totally handle this!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 我以前做过护工兼职，也能做好的...
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 我也做過看護，我很會照顧人的..
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 私も介護のバイトしてたから上手くできますけど…
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Tenang aja, aku pernah jadi caregiver—kayak gini mah gampang!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Eu já trabalhei cuidando de pacientes, também posso fazer isso...
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Yo he trabajado de cuidadora, también puedo hacerlo...
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: من قبلاً کنسرت های مراقبتی انجام داده ام - کاملاً می توانم این کار را انجام دهم!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Ugh, this is chaos! Yuman, you decide!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 哎呀，吵死了！让他自己来决定！
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 哎呀！吵死了！吳宥萬你自己來決定！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: もういい！ユマンさんが決めて！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Aduh, ribet banget! Yuman, kamu aja yang milih deh!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Ai, que bagunça… Yumán, decide você!
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: اوه، این هرج و مرج است! یومان، تو تصمیم بگیر!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Who do you want to get the water from?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Quem você quer que traga a água?
